text: This report recommends updates to the signatories required to authorize payments made by Toronto Atmospheric Fund. No changes are proposed to the established signing authorities for financial institution agreements or documents requiring approval by the City’s Chief Financial officer.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved the updates to signatories for payments outlined in Attachment 1 to the report (April 13, 2023) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Atmospheric Fund.
